pr_title: Fix bug in roon media player  to use correct 'seek position'  while playing a track.

## Proposed change
<!--

This PR fixes a bug where periodic updates from roon were resetting the media player position to an incorrect position.

## Type of change
<!--
  What type of change does your PR introduce to Home Assistant?
  NOTE: Please, check only 1! box!
  If your PR requires multiple boxes to be checked, you'll most likely need to

- [ ] Code quality improvements to existing code or addition of tests

## Additional information
<!--
  Details are important, and help maintainers processing your PR.
  Please be sure to fill out additional details, if applicable.
-->
The roon data structure holds two fields called `seek_position` the one held as part of the `now_playing` structure looks to represent the position that the player last started from (so either 0 if the track was played from the start, or a position if the track was seek positioned). This structure was being used when roon updated while a track was playing - with the result that at regular intervals the media player in HA would drop back to an incorrect position.

This PR changes the source of `seek_position` to use the field that does update as the track plays.

issue_context.title: Roon component resets reported position to 0 during playback (but not actual playback position)
issue_context.body:
### The problem

When playing media via the Roon component, every time `async_update_players` and `async_update_changed_players` are called during playback (approximately every 30 seconds), the reported position of the media player resets to 0. Audio playback is unaffected and continues uninterrupted. However this creates a discrepancy affecting other aspects of the media player, such as indications of progress or time remaining. i.e. a Roon media player could show you are 0:02 seconds into a 3:42 song, when in reality there are less than 0:10 seconds of playback remaining.

### What version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

core-2024.3.1

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

_No response_

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant OS

### Integration causing the issue

Roon

### Link to integration documentation on our website

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/roon/

### Diagnostics information

sample of debug logs that occur whenever position resets to 0 during playback. ( the `_on_state_change` lines continue repeatedly before and after the occasional `async_update_..` lines that occur every time the position resets)

```
2024-03-20 11:55:44.973 DEBUG (Thread-3) [roonapi] _on_state_change zones_seek_changed
2024-03-20 11:55:45.073 DEBUG (MainThread) [homeassistant.components.roon.server] async_update_players dict_keys(['1601f5b404a572d9ed4cacef696fd23916d5', '1601af8ab780296fecd6aebbc8d126f70fdc'])
2024-03-20 11:55:45.073 DEBUG (MainThread) [homeassistant.components.roon.server] async_update_changed_players dict_keys(['1601f5b404a572d9ed4cacef696fd23916d5', '1601af8ab780296fecd6aebbc8d126f70fdc'])
2024-03-20 11:55:45.975 DEBUG (Thread-3) [roonapi] _on_state_change zones_seek_changed
```
